# Quality Indicator Target

This folder contains the conceptual framework for quality indicator targets (developmental goals or *udviklingsmål*) used to benchmark clinical performance and ensure patient safety. It details the specific performance thresholds assigned to various clinical indicators, distinguishing between high-compliance targets for positive care processes and strict upper limits for adverse events.

## Pages

- [[quality-indicator-target|Quality Indicator Target]] — Defines the specific performance thresholds for clinical indicators, detailing exact percentage targets for both positive care processes and adverse event minimization.
